resources.string: Plan your tuition, exam, hostel, mess and other fees in ₹. Enter the amounts from your institution.
This is your personal fee ledger. Payments here are tracked separately from daily expenses; no money is transferred.
Enter a name, a valid due date and whole rupee amounts. Paid must be between zero and the total.
Remove this fee and its payment record from your ledger?
75% is a starting suggestion. Use your institution’s requirement; this does not certify exam eligibility. Only marked classes are counted.
Target: %1$d%% · Attend next %2$d marked classes to recover
Target: %1$d%% · You can miss %2$d further classes at this threshold
100% cannot be recovered after a recorded absence
Mark your classes to calculate attendance against your target.
Marks and grade points are different. Enter grade points on the 10-point scale only if your institution awards them; Semesta does not assume a marks-to-CGPA conversion.
Set your institution’s assessment weights: internal assessment, practicals, mid-semester tests and end-semester exams. They must add up to 100%.
